name: Swiss and Mushroom Stuffed Pork Chops

fit.evidence: 593 cal sits inside the 400-650 band; 3g carbs well under the 35g ceiling; pork whole-muscle bake, no seafood, weigh-and-divide scales cleanly to 14 servings.

dedupe.vs_catalog: KEEP - no stuffed pork chop exists in the 544-recipe catalog. Nearest pork-chop neighbor creamy-mushroom-pork-chops-over-mashed-potatoes shares only mushroom+pork (1 of 4): it is a cream-gravy skillet served over mashed potatoes, whereas this is a cheese-stuffed pocket bake with no starch base and no cream sauce - sauce family, starch, and method all differ. cheesy-pork-chop-and-hash-brown-casserole and farmhouse-pork-chop-stuffing-casserole are hash-brown/bread casseroles, not a stuffed chop.
dedupe.vs_accepted_run: KEEP - accepted-slugs carries creamy-garlic-herb-wine-pork-chops (a creamy wine skillet chop) which is a different dish; no stuffed or Swiss-mushroom pork chop accepted this run.

cross_protein_collision_watch: Filling is mushroom + Swiss + parsley stuffed into whole-muscle meat and baked. Decider should watch other selectors' pools for a structurally identical stuffed-cutlet twin in chicken or turkey (e.g. a 'mushroom-Swiss stuffed chicken breast' or 'stuffed turkey cutlet'). Not the same dish as the catalog's cordon-bleu casseroles (chicken-cordon-bleu-casserole, turkey-cordon-bleu-casserole) which also use swiss-cheese but are ham+rice casseroles, not a cheese-stuffed whole-muscle bake.

notes.cuisine: American - does not widen the American-skewed catalog on cuisine, but adds a stuffed-chop batch format the catalog lacks.
notes.unmapped: swiss-cheese is not on the board (catalog tracks cheddar/mozzarella/parmesan/cream-cheese/gruyere). Left as-is per v2.1 5.1 - absent-ingredient pick exercises the pricer lane, not a penalty.
